headline.text: L2 branch pump seized overnight — *5 hours down* clearing salt buildup, back running at 08:09.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran three lines with mixed results. Sollich 2 battled enrober temper spikes and a worn shaft coupler through first shift, cleared by 17:02, then hit a metal contamination event at 20:26 when an aluminum temperature cup broke into product — metal detector caught every piece, protocol established, no further hits after 06:57. Sollich 3 ran caramel clusters smoothly after clearing a tunnel jam at 03:51. Sollich 4 adjusted cooling tunnel temps to lift product weight into spec.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 Moulding Line 2 was down from 21:47 to 08:09 — 5 hours — on a seized branch pump motor. Salt and buildup locked the gears; maintenance disassembled, cleaned, greased, and reassembled. Line started depositing at 08:09, hit a printer fault at the start but cleared quickly. ML3 had a 12-minute feed belt stop at 07:06, back running at 07:19. Panning line ran clean all day.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 had a rough night. Truffle splitting table bearings failed at 03:40, line down until both were swapped at 05:11. M3 belt tracked off repeatedly — root cause was low guides and a misaligned eye sensor, fixed by Leon at 07:07, but tracking issues returned by 08:16 and a full belt replacement was underway at window close. ML1 cleared a clogged nozzle and a C6 belt off-track incident by mid-shift, then ran well. MF Matrix ran out of orange flavor at 06:37, adjusted the recipe to stretch toffee inventory, back running at 07:42. ML4 WDS commissioning continues with the vendor tech on-site.

notes.text: MLDZ audit completed — air systems back on for all shifts per Curt at 18:29.
Out of shrouds (item 41107) — 1st and 2nd shift sent home, delivery expected 09:00–10:00 today per Ethan Bean.
WDS tech David arrived last night, working with Nelson Cook and production to commission ML4 depositors and clear jam in cooling tunnel 3.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 enrober temper spikes and shaft coupler failure
resolved.summary: Enrober temper ran high starting at 11:40, decorator spiked repeatedly; spider/shaft coupler on return pump wore out at 12:43, causing pipe vibrations.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance replaced love joy bushing at 13:27 and spider by 13:40. Temper stabilized after three cycles, line started at 17:02.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 aluminum temperature cup contamination
resolved.summary: Piece of aluminum temperature cup found in product at 20:26, parts missing from the set; metal detector rejecting all pieces but x-ray not detecting.
resolved.resolution: Testing confirmed metal detector catches even smallest pieces on underside. Curt established protocol at 02:14: hourly MD checks, retest rejected product 3× while running, pause if pattern emerges. No further hits reported after 06:57.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 metal detector opening constantly
resolved.summary: Metal detector at 00:31 opened constantly with no product present, halting the line.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance fixed the issue by 00:52 — "Maintenence has fixed the issue" (Joseph Scott).

resolved.title: Sollich 2 steam leak on A2 kettle piping
resolved.summary: Steam leak discovered on A2 kettle piping in Sollich 2 kitchen at 12:51.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance fixed the steam leak by 13:10 (Victor Romero Sr.).

resolved.title: Sollich 2 Tunnel 3 belt slipping, product sticking
resolved.summary: Tunnel 3 belt slipped and product stuck at 17:31 due to salt buildup on drive rollers; air had been off during audit.
resolved.resolution: Team cleaned drive motor rollers and scrapers, line running at 18:26.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 Tunnel 2 jam and bent finel piece
resolved.summary: Product jammed against metal base in Tunnel 2 at 02:56, causing belt to stop and bending the finel piece.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance cleared jam, line back running at 03:51 (Luis Falcon).

resolved.title: Sollich 3 MM3 and MM5 wrong weights
resolved.summary: MM3 and MM5 combination weighers out of spec at 07:44.
resolved.resolution: Adjustments made on machines, fixed weight by 07:50 (Nancy Quiroz).

resolved.title: Sollich 2 product underweight and low decoration count
resolved.summary: At 07:50 product was underweight with insufficient decoration and 34–36 pieces per pouch (vs. spec).
resolved.resolution: Operator made adjustments, weight/decoration/count back in spec at 09:33 (Ingrid Moreno Angarita).

resolved.title: ML2 branch pump motor seized
resolved.summary: Branch pump motor locked up at 21:47 on 2nd shift; gears seized with salt and buildup, would not spin.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance disassembled pump, cleaned gears, separated lovejoy, greased internals, and reassembled. Pump spinning freely by 04:26, chocolate push completed at 04:40. Tempering and depositor install done, line started depositing at 08:09.

resolved.title: ML3 feed belt to firewall stopped
resolved.summary: Incoming feed to the firewall stopped at 07:06, line down.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance worked on it, line running at 07:19.

resolved.title: ML2 printer fault at startup
resolved.summary: Line ready to start at 08:30 but printer issues prevented start.
resolved.resolution: Hervin and Jorel resolved the printer issue, line running at 09:08.

resolved.title: Truffle enrober wire mesh broken
resolved.summary: Wire mesh on enrober broken at 11:43, line paused for repair.
resolved.resolution: Wire mesh fixed by 13:21, scraper reinstalled at 13:47. Waited for temper, started back up at 14:07.

resolved.title: Truffle splitting table bearings worn out
resolved.summary: Splitting table bearing came loose at 03:40, causing chocolate bites to stick together and pulling splitting bands to one side.
resolved.resolution: Both bearings worn out. Jose Vasquez retrieved replacements from L1. Both bearings replaced by 05:11.

resolved.title: ML1 C6 belt off track multiple times
resolved.summary: C6 belt tracked completely off at 04:49, happened three times by 05:52 while maintenance worked on it.
resolved.resolution: Leon identified root cause at 07:59: guides too low and tight, low-speed eye bracket angled wrong causing belt to stay at high speed during jams. Fixed guides and eye bracket, belt centered and running well at 10:56.

resolved.title: ML1 depositor nozzle clogged
resolved.summary: Nozzle clogged at 00:14, followed clogged nozzle flowchart.
resolved.resolution: Nozzle unclogged, started depositing and taking temper at 01:57. Line back up at 02:02.

resolved.title: MF Matrix out of orange flavor
resolved.summary: Line ran out of orange flavor at 06:37, stopping production.
resolved.resolution: Jenny Medina directed recipe adjustment at 07:23: reduce toffee by 2 pieces, add 1 dark and 1 orange to stay in spec and optimize quantity. Line running at 07:42.

resolved.title: Truffle Cavanna 1 sensor rejecting all chocolate
resolved.summary: Cavanna 1 sensor at 08:26 rejecting all chocolate, plus chocolate wasn't coming out right and plastic wrap not cutting properly.
resolved.resolution: Line paused at 08:27 for Chris to resolve. Cavanna 1 running well by 09:10.

resolved.title: MF Matrix bucket #2 fell off inside cone
resolved.summary: Bucket #2 fell off inside the cone at 08:52.
resolved.resolution: Bucket reinstalled, line running at 09:10 (Rich Brierley).

resolved.title: ML1 Bosch rail misalignment jamming chocolate
resolved.summary: Bosch machine stopped at 10:42, rails misaligned and jamming chocolate.
resolved.resolution: Bosch technician adjusted rails, machine started working again.

resolved.title: ML1 torn supersack
resolved.summary: Supersack torn at 00:36 during changeover.
resolved.resolution: Torn sack replaced and new one placed by 00:45 (Gina Vazquez).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 return pump faulting intermittently
needs_attention.summary: Return pump faulting out starting at 20:17, team resetting it each time it faults.
needs_attention.status: Team continues resetting pump when it faults as of 20:17. No further updates on root cause or permanent fix by window close.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 non-allergen milk buffer tank valve failed
needs_attention.summary: Valve failed at 01:49, causing tank to be filled and overfilled by the melting tank en route to the nut buffer tank.
needs_attention.status: Valve failure reported at 01:49 with photo. No resolution or follow-up by window close.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 small pieces falling below weight again
needs_attention.summary: At 10:30, small pieces observed falling below required weight after earlier fix.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 10:30. No follow-up on adjustments or resolution by window close at 11:02.

needs_attention.title: Truffle M3 belt replacement in progress
needs_attention.summary: M3 belt tracking issues returned at 08:16 despite earlier fix; Chris started full belt replacement at 09:22.
needs_attention.status: Belt replacement started at 09:22. No completion reported by window close. Shawn noted concern at 09:35 about seized nosebar roller on southwest side needing replacement at same time.

needs_attention.title: ML4 WDS commissioning ongoing with vendor tech
needs_attention.summary: WDS system commissioning continues with vendor tech David on-site; system powered down for work, encountered stuck switch at 06:55, depositor centerlines completed by 08:47, jam in cooling tunnel 3 at 09:09.
needs_attention.status: Vendor tech David on-site working with Nelson Cook and production. Depositor centerlines completed by 08:47, clearing jam in cooling tunnel 3 as of 09:09. System not yet fully operational.
